technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for embedded server support and flexible deployment scenarios.
Leverage Spring Integration for stream processing, channel management, and interception for tracing.
Implement resource cleanup using Spring lifecycle callbacks (e.g., SmartLifecycle) to ensure proper release of message bus resources.
Use Java properties files or YAML for deployment manifests to allow external configuration, reducing inline typing.
Add tracing via Spring Integration wiretap channels or custom interceptors to enable module-level progress tracking.
Develop reference architectures as separate Spring XD project templates with documentation for POC building.
Incorporate side channels dynamically during stream deployment to support additional tracing without altering primary channels.
assumptions: The developer has access to the existing Spring XD codebase and is proficient with Spring Framework and Spring Integration.
The implementation is incremental, modifying or extending existing Spring XD modules without major architectural overhauls.
Development environment includes necessary tools (e.g., Maven, IDE, Spring XD server) and dependencies are pre-configured.
Effort estimates include coding, unit testing, and basic integration checks, but exclude extensive QA or performance tuning.
Time for learning and ramp-up on Spring XD specifics is included in the analysis and design phase.
User stories are prioritized, and all are implemented within this increment without dependencies on external systems.
Reference architectures (U5) involve creating sample projects and documentation, not deploying live systems.
The taxi trip analytics application (U8) is a standalone study project using Spring XD, based on available data sources.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all user stories (U1-U8), understand existing Spring XD architecture, and design technical solutions for each feature. Create detailed specifications and workflows.
Develop code to clean up message bus resources (queues/topics) when a stream is destroyed, including handling stale resources. Integrate with Spring XD stream lifecycle management.
Allow modification of deployed or undeployed streams by updating deployment properties without requiring stream destruction. Implement change detection and hot-reload if feasible.
Add support for loading deployment properties from external files (e.g., .properties, .yml) to replace inline properties. Implement file parsing and validation.
Create reference architecture templates and documentation for Spring XD, capturing domain-specific ideas to aid in building POCs. Include sample streams and configurations.
Introduce optional trace properties for streams to enable logging or notifications at specified modules. Use Spring Integration interceptors or wiretap channels for implementation.
Enable creation of optional side channels during stream deployment for tracing within flows. Allow dynamic addition of channels to the bus for tracking module progress.
Develop a sample application using Spring XD to analyze taxi trip data streams from NYC for real-time analytics evaluation. Implement data ingestion and processing pipelines.
Conduct integration testing of all implemented features (U1-U8) in a Spring XD environment to verify correctness, interoperability, and performance.
Write comprehensive user guides, API documentation, and deployment instructions. Prepare release notes and package the increment for deployment.
